source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means (risk TRUE in context sandbox) or action delete; critical cases require allow. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context sandbox returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers review at priority 90. Trusted means role auditor, or context internal with FALSE risk; a trusted change prefers deny at priority 80. Action inspect in context sandbox prefers allow at priority 70. Role analyst and context partner prefers review at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid review. All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means (risk TRUE in context sandbox) or action delete; critical cases require allow.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context sandbox returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers review at priority 90.
Trusted means role auditor, or context internal with FALSE risk; a trusted change prefers deny at priority 80.
Action inspect in context sandbox prefers allow at priority 70.
Role analyst and context partner prefers review at priority 40.
All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
forbidden_shortcuts: Use every field named by a relevant rule.

repairs.original_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    ((event.risk == TRUE) and (event.context == sandbox)) or (event.action == delete)

predicate Trusted(event):
    (event.role == auditor) or ((event.context == internal) and (event.risk == FALSE))

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == sandbox)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = allow

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRisk:
    when event.risk == UNKNOWN
    then prefer label = review priority 90

rule TrustedChange:
    when Trusted(event)
    then prefer label = deny priority 80, forbid label = review

rule InspectSandbox:
    when (event.action == inspect) and (event.context == sandbox)
    then prefer label = allow priority 70

rule AnalystPartner:
    when (event.role == analyst) and (event.context == partner)
    then prefer label = review priority 40

rule OtherRoles:
    when ((event.role != auditor) and (event.role != analyst)) and (event.role != guest)
    then prefer label = deny priority 1

rendered_bundle: Verified decision tree. Match the one leaf whose field conditions all hold, then return its label. Every declared input matches exactly one leaf.
If context=internal, action=change, risk=FALSE, return deny.
If context=internal, action=change, risk=TRUE, return deny.
If context=internal, action=change, risk=UNKNOWN, role=analyst, return review.
If context=internal, action=change, risk=UNKNOWN, role=auditor, return deny.
If context=internal, action=change, risk=UNKNOWN, role=guest, return review.
If context=internal, action=delete, return allow.
If context=internal, action=inspect, risk=FALSE, return deny.
If context=internal, action=inspect, risk=TRUE, return deny.
If context=internal, action=inspect, risk=UNKNOWN, role=analyst, return review.
If context=internal, action=inspect, risk=UNKNOWN, role=auditor, return deny.
If context=internal, action=inspect, risk=UNKNOWN, role=guest, return review.
If context=partner, action=change, role=analyst, return review.
If context=partner, action=change, role=auditor, return deny.
If context=partner, action=change, role=guest, risk=FALSE, return deny.
If context=partner, action=change, role=guest, risk=TRUE, return deny.
If context=partner, action=change, role=guest, risk=UNKNOWN, return review.
If context=partner, action=delete, return allow.
If context=partner, action=inspect, role=analyst, return review.
If context=partner, action=inspect, role=auditor, return deny.
If context=partner, action=inspect, role=guest, risk=FALSE, return deny.
If context=partner, action=inspect, role=guest, risk=TRUE, return deny.
If context=partner, action=inspect, role=guest, risk=UNKNOWN, return review.
If context=sandbox, risk=FALSE, action=change, return deny.

If context=sandbox, risk=FALSE, action=inspect, role=guest, return allow.
If context=sandbox, risk=TRUE, return allow.
If context=sandbox, risk=UNKNOWN, return uncertain.
deployment_description: Classify one structured event using the supplied compiled instructions. The allowed outputs are deny, allow, review, uncertain. These names are arbitrary symbols, so do not infer their meaning. Copy the output stated by the matching compiled instruction.
